repo.name: aspcud
repo.description: A solver for package problems in CUDF format

readme.summary: Minimal README that gives a high-level description and basic usage but defers most details to external files and links, leaving new users with significant gaps.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting guidance and installation instructions are entirely delegated to a separate INSTALL.md with no inline content.

injection_risks.description: The exec_ function is used with user-controlled input (cudf2lp_args, gringo_args, clasp_args), which can lead to command injection attacks.

security.summary: The aspcud package has several security concerns, including command injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, which can lead to serious security issues if not addressed.
